Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosed:** The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Rolled back:** Reverted all regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release with a healthy production status.
- **Verified:** checkout-api is now healthy across all regions, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** Opened a **SEV2** incident (INC-0001) documenting the failed deploy and the rollback; the on-call engineer was paged.
